summary: Prepare verified compatibility archives once per workflow and share them across runner types through run-scoped artifacts

replay.detail: CI transport and cache changes only.

compatibility.detail: Pinned SHA256 and BUILD.json source/target validation remain mandatory, including restored cache entries.

manual.detail: Workflow preparation and bounded browser download retries are automatic. Archive producers participate in draft admission, queue dependency observation and projected proof graphs; source-history checkout/fetch steps remain adjacent.
